description: This Rust source file implements database query execution and result streaming for a web server, including handling of SQL statements, parameter binding, JSON conversion, delayed functions, and error handling.

classes.name: StatementWithParams
classes.description: A wrapper for SQL statements with bound parameters, supporting execution and argument management.

methods.name: prepare_with
methods.description: Prepares an SQL statement with parameter types, returning a statement object.

methods.name: stream_query_results_with_conn
methods.description: Streams query results based on parsed SQL file and execution context, handling various statement types.

methods.name: stop_at_first_error
methods.description: Transforms a stream to stop processing after the first error, emitting the error item.

methods.name: exec_static_simple_select
methods.description: Executes static simple select statements, returning JSON object with computed values.

methods.name: try_rollback_transaction
methods.description: Attempts to rollback a database transaction.

methods.name: extract_req_param_as_json
methods.description: Extracts a request parameter as JSON value, returning null if absent.

methods.name: stream_query_results_boxed
methods.description: Creates a boxed stream of query results for recursive use.

methods.name: execute_set_variable_query
methods.description: Executes a query to set a variable in the database context.

methods.name: execute_set_simple_static
methods.description: Sets a static variable value based on a simple select value.

methods.name: vars_and_name
methods.description: Determines variable map and name for setting variables, with validation.

methods.name: take_connection
methods.description: Acquires a database connection from the pool if not already available.

methods.name: parse_single_sql_result
methods.description: Parses SQL query result into a DbItem, handling errors.

methods.name: debug_row
methods.description: Logs detailed information about a database row for debugging.

methods.name: apply_delayed_functions
methods.description: Applies delayed functions to a database row, possibly opening new connections.

methods.name: apply_single_delayed_function
methods.description: Applies a single delayed function to a database row, updating its JSON fields.

methods.name: json_to_fn_param
methods.description: Converts JSON value to function parameter format.

methods.name: apply_json_columns
methods.description: Converts stringified JSON columns in a row to actual JSON objects or arrays.
